name: Ketamine
tierNotes: Threshold: near-clean — the faintest softness only.

Light: still very close to clean; only acuity/desat/coolCast are perceptibly non-zero, and only just. The shared breathing/drift/flowWarp trio (the same surfaces-bow-along-their-own-contours mechanics most other substances use for baseline life) are on the 'late' curve, so they're barely present yet — enough that the render is never a dead static filter, not enough to read as distortion. No black surround at all — the frame is fully rectangular.

Common: much less blur than before — flatten's own onset is pushed later, and the shared acuity/dof params (generic blur/depth-of-field, previously on the smooth curve and already noticeably soft here) are now on the late curve too, so Common reads mostly sharp. In their place, a modest, genuinely colourful touch: the dissolve pattern (kDissolve — flat/posterized but still colour-shifted from the photo's own dominant palette) now onsets from Common instead of waiting for Strong, so surfaces show the first hint of psychedelic colour-patterning without yet losing the photo. breathing/drift/flowWarp are clearly perceptible — walls and surfaces visibly bow/crawl along their own contours, gently — but stay well short of their ceiling (late curve); world recession hasn't woken up yet, so there's no black surround at all. (Perf/lag fix retained: no shared patternMask/symmetry on this profile, so P3 stays skipped; stutter stays rare until Strong/Heavy.)

Strong: only a small black margin so far — world recession and the k-hole surround use a deliberately sudden two-part curve (feedback: the k-hole should feel like a discrete threshold, not a smooth ramp, and Strong shouldn't be 'covered by the black' but should still give a psychedelic vibe of its own) so the black stays modest here. What DOES carry Strong is genuinely colourful psychedelic-esque content: environmental cubism/scenery-slicing (PsychonautWiki's own documented ketamine geometry — 'algorithmic... synthetic... simplistic in complexity', milder and less intricate than a psychedelic fractal) across 11 facets with hard posterize banding, PLUS the dissolve pattern-crawl (now well past halfway to its own ceiling, having started back in Common) — flat, breathing, texture-masked, colour-shifted pattern woven through much of the photo without any black surround to speak of; flatten/acuity/dof (all late curve) are also well underway now, so the 'painting' softness proper to ketamine finally arrives here rather than in Common; breathing/drift/flowWarp are well past halfway to their ceiling too, so the whole frame is visibly alive.

Heavy: the k-hole arrives suddenly in the last stretch of the slider — recession and the surround darkening both spike hard between Strong and here (same total magnitude as before at full Heavy, just concentrated into a rapid final ramp instead of spread across the whole Strong->Heavy range), so moving the slider the last few percent should feel like falling through a trapdoor rather than a gradual fade. Cubism is at its ceiling across 11 facets with starker posterize contrast; the receded painting's structure crawls/breathes via a real 2D domain-warp, and its colour gives way hard to the same continuous, texture/luminance-masked pattern that started in Strong, now at full strength with a thin graphic band-edge contour line (an ink-like darkening, not a highlight) — flat, posterized, desaturated-cool, tinted from the photo's own dominant palette. Takes inspiration from the psychedelics' structure-driven pattern language while staying in ketamine's own documented 'algorithmic'/low-complexity register, never LSD/DMT's rainbow or fractal tiling.
